description: E-book generation (EPUB and PDF): Implement POST /api/generate-ebook endpoint that reads cached chapters, validates minimum 3 chapters, and generates EPUB using epub-gen or PDF using Puppeteer. Handles cover images, metadata, TOC, styling, and error recovery.

Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/frontend/pages/api/generate-ebook.ts (POST endpoint) that: (1) parse request {novelId, format: 'epub'|'pdf'}, (2) validate novelId (64-char hex), validate format in ['epub', 'pdf'], (3) call validateChapters(novelId), if <3 chapters return 422 {error: 'Insufficient chapters', completedChapters, code: 'INSUFFICIENT_CHAPTERS'}, (4) try generateEpub or generatePdf based on format, (5) on success: set response headers Content-Type (application/epub+zip or application/pdf), Content-Disposition: attachment; filename='{title}.epub', (6) stream file from disk using fs.createReadStream, (7) on error (Puppeteer unavailable): return 503 {error: 'PDF generation unavailable. findings: Requires FEAT-001 (database + storage) and FEAT-004 (queue) to have chapters cached. Puppeteer will auto-download Chromium (~150MB) on first use; cache this in CI to avoid repeated downloads. sharp library is included in FEAT-001 for image resizing. Test data should use mock chapters rather than live scraping.
